steps.say: Chemotherapy before cystectomy is proven to extend life. Cisplatin doublets are given for muscle invasive disease. Accelerated MVAC or gemcitabine cisplatin are listed as the accepted pairings. Absolute survival is lifted by five to eight percent at five years. Fitness for cisplatin is confirmed by renal and hearing checks. Cystectomy is performed after the courses are finished.
steps.tx: **Neoadjuvant cisplatin** (chemotherapy before surgery) with accelerated **MVAC** (methotrexate vinblastine doxorubicin cisplatin) or gemcitabine cisplatin lifts absolute overall survival by **5% to 8%** (five to eight in a hundred) at **5 years** (five years) in muscle invasive disease. Confirm cisplatin fitness with renal function, hearing, and performance checks, because carboplatin substitution weakens the **survival advantage** (life extending benefit). Time cystectomy promptly after chemotherapy, because delay lets tumours regrow.

steps.say: Radical cystectomy removes the bladder with neighbouring organs. In men the prostate with seminal vesicles and distal ureters are taken. Regional nodes are cleared in the same operation. In women the urethra with uterus, ovaries, and anterior vaginal wall are removed. The operation is called anterior pelvic exenteration. Sexual and urinary function are counselled beforehand.
steps.tx: **Radical cystectomy** (bladder removal with neighbours) in men takes bladder, prostate, seminal vesicles, distal ureters, and regional nodes, while in women **anterior pelvic exenteration** (front pelvis clearance) takes bladder, urethra, uterus, ovaries, and anterior vaginal wall. Both operations clear regional lymph nodes with the specimen. Counsel continence, sexual function, and stoma or neobladder choice before surgery, because reconstruction is planned together.

steps.say: Node clearance is part of every cystectomy. At least ten to fifteen nodes are expected by pathologists. External iliac packets are taken from both sides. Internal iliac with obturator tissue is added routinely. Extended templates reach higher chains in selected cases. More nodes sharpen staging and may improve control.
steps.tx: **Pelvic lymph node dissection** (node clearance) at cystectomy should yield at least **10 to 15 nodes** (ten to fifteen glands), spanning external iliac, internal iliac (hypogastric), and **obturator nodes** (side wall packets). Extended templates add common iliac and presacral chains in higher risk disease. Send fresh tissue labelled by packet, because mapped positivity guides adjuvant therapy.

steps.say: The ileal conduit is trusted as the most reliable diversion. A fifteen to twenty cm segment of terminal ileum is isolated. The length is taken fifteen cm above the ileocecal valve. Ureters are joined to one end of the piece. The other end is shaped into a stoma on the belly. An external bag is emptied around the clock by the patient.
steps.tx: **Ileal conduit** (Bricker diversion) isolates a **15 cm to 20 cm** (fifteen to twenty centimetre) segment of terminal ileum taken **15 cm** (fifteen centimetres) proximal to the ileocecal valve, the most reliable incontinent diversion. Ureters join the closed end while the open end matures as a stoma for an external bag. Teach stoma care and night drainage before discharge, because early confidence prevents readmission.

steps.say: Fit patients are offered a neobladder instead of a bag. Fifty to sixty cm of ileum is detubularized and reshaped. The Studer and Hautmann designs are taught as the standard pouches. The reservoir is joined directly to the native urethral stump. Day continence returns in most patients with training. Night leakage is accepted as more common.
steps.tx: **Orthotopic neobladder** (new bladder in place), built as a **Studer pouch** (ileal reservoir) or Hautmann design from **50 cm to 60 cm** (fifty to sixty centimetres) of **detubularized ileum** (opened flat bowel), joins the native urethral stump for volitional voiding. Select motivated patients with good renal function and clean urethral margins. Train timed voiding with pelvic floor drills, because the new reservoir has no detrusor squeeze.

steps.say: Bowel in the urinary tract changes salt handling. Ammonium with chloride is reabsorbed from stored urine. Bicarbonate with sodium is swapped away in exchange. Hyperchloremic metabolic acidosis is established over months. Bone is drained as it buffers the acid over years. Alkali tablets are prescribed with salt checks on follow up.
steps.tx: **Hyperchloremic metabolic acidosis** (acid blood from bowel diversion) is the classic **electrolyte disturbance** (salt upset) after ileal or colonic diversions, as ammonium and chloride are reabsorbed in exchange for lost bicarbonate and sodium. Chronic buffering thins bone and favours stones over years. Prescribe oral alkali with periodic bicarbonate and vitamin D checks, because silent drift harms kidneys and bone.

steps.say: Selected patients are managed while keeping their bladder. Maximal TURBT is performed to remove all visible tumour. Concurrent chemoradiotherapy is added to sterilize the bed. Solitary T2 tumours without hydronephrosis are picked. Extensive CIS is excluded before this path is chosen. Survival is matched to cystectomy in careful series.
steps.tx: **Trimodal therapy** (bladder saving triad) of maximal TURBT followed by concurrent **chemoradiotherapy** (combined drug and radiation) matches cystectomy survival in selected patients with solitary T2 tumours, no hydronephrosis, and no extensive CIS. Commit to lifelong cystoscopic surveillance with prompt salvage cystectomy for recurrence, because preserved bladders need watching.

steps.say: Metastatic urothelial cancer is treated with a new first line standard. Enfortumab vedotin is aimed at Nectin-4 on tumour cells. Pembrolizumab is added to release immune brakes. The pairing is extended to locally advanced disease. Progression free with overall survival are improved together. Neuropathy with skin toxicity is watched on treatment.
steps.tx: **Enfortumab vedotin** (Nectin-4 antibody drug conjugate) with **pembrolizumab** (checkpoint immunotherapy) is the first line standard for locally advanced or metastatic urothelial cancer, improving progression free and overall survival together. The conjugate delivers cell killing payload to **Nectin-4** (tumour surface target) bearing cells. Monitor skin, neuropathy, and glucose, because toxicities differ from chemotherapy.
